67	 *         = 25MHz / 25 * 396 / 3 / 4 = 33MHz
68	 */
69	
70	#define GD32_TLI_PLL2_PSC             25
71	#define GD32_TLI_PLL2_N               396
72	#define GD32_TLI_PLL2_P               3    /* unused by TLI, keep valid */
73	#define GD32_TLI_PLL2_R               3

77	 * Control signals:  DE=PF10, VSYNC=PA7, HSYNC=PC6, PCLK=PG7 (all AF14)
78	 * Backlight:        BL=PJ9   (push-pull output)
79	 * Reset:            RST=PJ11 (push-pull output)
80	 * Data R:   PG6(AF14) R7, PB1(AF9) R6, PA9(AF14) R5, PA5(AF14) R4,
81	 *           PB0(AF9) R3, PA1(AF14) R2, PA2(AF14) R1, PG13(AF14) R0
82	 * Data G:   PK2(AF14) G7, PC7(AF14) G6, PB11(AF14) G5, PB10(AF14) G4,
83	 *           PJ10(AF14) G3, PA6(AF14) G2, PE6(AF14) G1, PE5(AF14) G0
84	 * Data B:   PB9(AF14) B7, PA15(AF14) B6, PB5(AF3) B5, PG12(AF9) B4,

236	/****************************************************************************
237	 * Name: gd32_tli_clock_config
238	 *
239	 * Description:
240	 *   Configure the PLL2 clock to generate the TLI pixel clock (9 MHz for
241	 *   the 4.3 inch panel) and enable the TLI peripheral clock.
242	 *
243	 ****************************************************************************/
244	
245	static int gd32_tli_clock_config(void)
246	{
247	  uint32_t regval;
248	  uint32_t timeout;
249	
250	  /* Enable the TLI peripheral clock (APB3) */
251	
252	  modifyreg32(GD32_RCU_APB3EN, 0, RCU_APB3EN_TLIEN);
253	
254	  /* Configure PLL2 input/output clock range (wide VCO, 1-2MHz input) */
255	
256	  modifyreg32(GD32_RCU_PLLALL,
257	              RCU_PLLALL_PLL2RNG_MASK | RCU_PLLALL_PLL2VCOSEL, 0);
258	
259	  /* Configure PLL2: PSC, N, P, R */
260	
261	  regval = RCU_PLL2_PLL2PSC(GD32_TLI_PLL2_PSC) |
262	           RCU_PLL2_PLL2N(GD32_TLI_PLL2_N) |
263	           RCU_PLL2_PLL2P(GD32_TLI_PLL2_P) |
264	           RCU_PLL2_PLL2R(GD32_TLI_PLL2_R);
265	  putreg32(regval, GD32_RCU_PLL2);
266	
267	  /* Enable the PLL2R clock output */
268	
269	  modifyreg32(GD32_RCU_PLLADDCTL, 0, RCU_PLLADDCTL_PLL2REN);
270	
271	  /* Configure the TLI clock divider from PLL2R (CK_TLI = CK_PLL2R / 8) */
272	
273	  modifyreg32(GD32_RCU_CFG1, RCU_CFG1_PLL2RDIV_MASK,
274	              (uint32_t)GD32_TLI_PLL2RDIV << RCU_CFG1_PLL2RDIV_SHIFT);
275	
276	  /* Enable PLL2 and wait until it is stable */
277	
278	  modifyreg32(GD32_RCU_CTL, 0, RCU_CTL_PLL2EN);
279	
280	  timeout = 1000000;
281	  while ((getreg32(GD32_RCU_CTL) & RCU_CTL_PLL2STB) == 0)
282	    {
283	      if (--timeout == 0)
284	        {
285	          lcderr("ERROR: PLL2 did not lock\n");
286	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
287	        }
288	    }
289	
290	  lcdinfo("TLI pixel clock configured: %d Hz\n",
291	          (25 * 1000000) / GD32_TLI_PLL2_PSC * GD32_TLI_PLL2_N /
292	          GD32_TLI_PLL2_R / (1U << (GD32_TLI_PLL2RDIV + 1)));
293	
294	  return OK;
295	}

350	/****************************************************************************
351	 * Name: gd32_spin_delay_ms
352	 *
353	 * Description:
354	 *   Millisecond delay implemented with the DWT cycle counter.  This is
355	 *   deliberately NOT up_udelay(): after a warm reset the SysTick-based
356	 *   delay can stall (the v61..v63 boot hang happened exactly inside the
357	 *   panel-reset 50ms busy-wait), while the cycle counter only depends on
358	 *   the CPU core clock (600 MHz) which is always running.
359	 *
360	 ****************************************************************************/
361	
362	static void gd32_spin_delay_ms(uint32_t ms)
363	{
364	  volatile uint32_t *demcr   = (volatile uint32_t *)0xe000edfcu;
365	  volatile uint32_t *dwtctrl = (volatile uint32_t *)0xe0001000u;
366	  volatile uint32_t *cyccnt  = (volatile uint32_t *)0xe0001004u;
367	  uint32_t start;
368	
369	  *demcr   |= (1u << 24);                 /* DWT TRCENA */
370	  *dwtctrl |= 1u;                         /* DWT CYCCNTENA */
371	  start = *cyccnt;
372	  while ((*cyccnt - start) < ms * (600000000u / 1000u))
373	    ;
374	}

376	/****************************************************************************
377	 * Name: gd32_tli_panel_reset
378	 *
379	 * Description:
380	 *   Hardware reset the LCD panel and turn on the backlight.
381	 *
382	 ****************************************************************************/
383	
384	static void gd32_tli_panel_reset(void)
385	{
386	  /* Panel reset with the exact timing of the working example (experiment
387	   * 33): RST high -> 10ms -> low -> 50ms -> high -> 200ms.  The example
388	   * does this AFTER the TLI is enabled, so the pixel clock is already
389	   * running when the panel comes out of reset; skipping this sequence
390	   * leaves the panel T-CON uninitialized, which is exactly the
391	   * stretched/repeated-pixel symptom we saw in the "skip reset" builds.
392	   * Spin delays are used so this can never hang on SysTick.
393	   */
394	
395	  gd32_gpio_write(GPIO_TLI_RST, true);
396	  gd32_spin_delay_ms(10);
397	  gd32_gpio_write(GPIO_TLI_RST, false);
398	  gd32_spin_delay_ms(50);
399	  gd32_gpio_write(GPIO_TLI_RST, true);
400	  gd32_spin_delay_ms(200);
401	
402	  /* Backlight: power on and report the pin level. */
403	
404	  gd32_gpio_write(GPIO_TLI_BL, true);
405	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "TLI: backlight on (PJ9 OCTL=%08x)\n",
406	         getreg32(GD32_GPIO_OCTL(GD32_GPIOJ_BASE)));
407	}

413	/****************************************************************************
414	 * Name: gd32_tli_initialize
415	 *
416	 * Description:
417	 *   Initialize the TLI controller, configure the layer 0 and enable the
418	 *   display.  The frame buffer is left untouched here (it is cleared by
419	 *   the framebuffer core at registration time).
420	 *
421	 ****************************************************************************/
422	
423	int gd32_tli_initialize(void)
424	{
425	  extern void gd32_sdram_initialize(void);
426	  uint32_t layer0;
427	  uint32_t wlp;
428	  uint32_t wrp;
429	  uint32_t wtp;
430	  uint32_t wbp;
431	  uint32_t hsw   = GD32_TLI_HSW;
432	  uint32_t hbp   = GD32_TLI_HBP;
433	  uint32_t vsw   = GD32_TLI_VSW;
434	  uint32_t vbp   = GD32_TLI_VBP;
435	  uint32_t pwidth  = CONFIG_GD32H7XX_TLI_XRES;
436	  uint32_t pheight = CONFIG_GD32H7XX_TLI_YRES;
437	
438	  /* Configure TLI pixel clock and GPIO pins */
439	
440	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "TLI: init start\n");
441	
442	  /* The 800x480 RGB565 frame buffer lives in the external SDRAM
443	   * (0xC0000000) because it is larger than the internal AXI SRAM.
444	   * Bring the SDRAM up first.
445	   */
446	
447	  gd32_sdram_initialize();
448	
449	  if (gd32_tli_clock_config() != OK)
450	    {
451	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "TLI: clock config FAILED\n");
452	      return -EIO;
453	    }
454	
455	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "TLI: pixel clock 33MHz OK\n");
456	
457	  gd32_tli_gpio_config();
458	
459	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "TLI: gpio configured\n");
460	
461	  /* Configure TLI timing registers
462	   *
463	   * SPSZ: vpsz = vsw-1, hpsz = hsw-1
464	   * BPSZ: vbpsz = vsw+vbp-1, hbpsz = hsw+hbp-1
465	   * ASZ:  vasz = vsw+vbp+pheight-1, hasz = hsw+hbp+pwidth-1
466	   * TSZ:  vtsz = vsw+vbp+pheight+vfp-1, htsz = hsw+hbp+pwidth+hfp-1
467	   */
468	
469	  putreg32((vsw - 1) | ((hsw - 1) << 16), GD32_TLI_SPSZ);
470	  putreg32((vsw + vbp - 1) | ((hsw + hbp - 1) << 16), GD32_TLI_BPSZ);
471	  putreg32((vsw + vbp + pheight - 1) |
472	           ((hsw + hbp + pwidth - 1) << 16), GD32_TLI_ASZ);
473	  putreg32((vsw + vbp + pheight + GD32_TLI_VFP - 1) |
474	           ((hsw + hbp + pwidth + GD32_TLI_HFP - 1) << 16), GD32_TLI_TSZ);
475	
476	  /* Background color: white */
477	
478	  putreg32(0xff | (0xff << 8) | (0xff << 16), GD32_TLI_BGC);
479	
480	  /* Signal polarity: HS/VS/DE active low, pixel clock not inverted
481	   * (all polarity bits remain 0).
482	   */
483	
484	  /* Configure layer 0 */
485	
486	  layer0 = GD32_TLI_LAYER0;
487	
488	  wlp = hsw + hbp;
489	  /* Layer window: the example uses right = pwidth + hsw + hbp - 1, i.e.
490	   * an 800-pixel window (NOT 832).  The window position registers are
491	   * written directly by tli_layer_init from layer_window_leftpos /
492	   * layer_window_rightpos; they do NOT come from FLL.
493	   */
494	  wrp = pwidth + hsw + hbp - 1;
495	  wtp = vsw + vbp;
496	  wbp = pheight + vsw + vbp - 1;
497	
498	  putreg32(wlp | (wrp << 16), GD32_TLI_LXHPOS(layer0));
499	  putreg32(wtp | (wbp << 16), GD32_TLI_LXVPOS(layer0));
500	  putreg32(LAYER_PPF_RGB565, GD32_TLI_LXPPF(layer0));
501	  putreg32(255, GD32_TLI_LXSA(layer0));
502	  putreg32(0, GD32_TLI_LXDC(layer0));
503	  putreg32(LAYER_ACF1_PASA | LAYER_ACF2_PASA, GD32_TLI_LXBLEND(layer0));
504	  putreg32(CONFIG_GD32H7XX_TLI_FB_BASE, GD32_TLI_LXFBADDR(layer0));
505	
506	  /* Line length (FLL) and stride offset (STDOFF) - take the exact values
507	   * of the GD official TLI example (experiment 33), which is verified to
508	   * display correctly on this same panel:
509	   *   STDOFF = (800 + (64 - 800 % 64)) * 2 = 1664
510	   *   FLL    = 1664 + 7 = 1671
511	   * The example writes the 800-pixel frame buffer with pwidth*y+x (an
512	   * 800-pixel stride) while the TLI is configured with STDOFF=1664, and
513	   * it works on this panel; replicate it exactly rather than reasoning
514	   * about it.
515	   */
516	
517	  /* v18: SELF-CONSISTENT line length / stride for the 800px panel.
518	   * The GD library computes STDOFF = (800 + 64 - 800%64) * 2 = 1664
519	   * (64px-aligned), but the panel is only 800px wide, so the TLI reads
520	   * 832px of frame-buffer data per line while only 800px are visible:
521	   * the extra 32px get spread over the line, repeating one pixel every
522	   * 25 pixels -> evenly-spaced ghost lines + horizontal stretch.
523	   * The F429 reference project for this same 800x480 panel uses
524	   * CFBLR = 1600<<16|1607 (line length 1600B + 7, stride 1600B), which
525	   * is self-consistent.  Use the same values here.
526	   */
527	  putreg32(1671 | (1664 << 16), GD32_TLI_LXFLLEN(layer0));   /* v25: example values */
528	  putreg32(pheight, GD32_TLI_LXFTLN(layer0));
529	
530	  /* Disable all TLI interrupts.  The TLI status register shows the
531	   * line/FIFO/transfer flags set once the controller starts (STAT=0x0f);
532	   * leaving INTEN enabled would let the TLI raise interrupts that this
533	   * driver never services, disturbing the system timer/scheduler.
534	   */
535	
536	  putreg32(0, GD32_TLI_INTEN);
537	
538	  /* Reset the panel BEFORE enabling the TLI.  The 50ms/200ms panel
539	   * reset busy-waits now run with no pixel clock / TLI DMA traffic, so
540	   * they cannot be disturbed by TLI+SDRAM bus contention.  (With the

664	      y0 >= CONFIG_GD32H7XX_TLI_YRES)

667	    }

In the contest delivery repo (`contest2026_471_sibakenailongshiyanshi`), the
`board/contest_board/` tree holds *archived copies* of sources that are really
built from elsewhere - nothing under `board/` is compiled. There is no sync
script; the `_sym*.sh` / `_build.sh` scripts in the workspace root are only
ad-hoc diagnostics.

Build-tree source of truth (verified 2026-09-11):

| Repo path | Real source |
|---|---|
| `board/.../gd32h7xx_tli.c` / `.h` | `nuttx/arch/arm/src/gd32h7xx/` |
| `board/.../gd32h7xx_sdram.c` | `nuttx/arch/arm/src/gd32h7xx/` |
| `board/.../gd32h7xx_gpio.h` | `nuttx/arch/arm/src/gd32h7xx/` |
| `board/contest_board/src/gd32h7xx_bringup.c` | `vendor/gigadevice/boards/gd32h7/gd32h759imt6/src/` |
| `board/contest_board/src/gd32h7xx_gt911.c` | `vendor/gigadevice/boards/gd32h7/gd32h759imt6/src/` |
| `app/gui/` | `apps/examples/gui/` |

**Why:** these copies fall out of date silently. When checked, the `board/`
copies were dated 2026-09-03 while the working sources were 2026-09-07 - they
were missing the DWT panel-reset delay fix (the v61..v63 boot hang),
`gd32_tli_enable()/disable()` and the pinned SDCTL value 0x59D9.

**How to apply:** before committing to the delivery repo, diff every `board/`
copy against its real source rather than trusting it. If a copy is stale,
refresh the whole file - do not try to apply only your own edit on top of a
stale base, that produces a file that never compiled.

See [[contest-build-vm]].

def main() -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Export AI Coding sessions from staging to demo repo logs/.",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument("--list", action="store_true",
                   help="List all sessions in staging without exporting.")
    p.add_argument("--latest", action="store_true",
                   help="Export only the most recent session.")
    p.add_argument("--session", metavar="SID",
                   help="Export a specific session by id.")
    p.add_argument("--today", action="store_true",
                   help="Export sessions from today (UTC).")
    p.add_argument("--since", metavar="DATE",
                   help="Export sessions since a date (YYYY-MM-DD).")
    p.add_argument("--all", action="store_true",
                   help="Export every session in staging.")
    p.add_argument("--backfill", action="store_true",
                   help="Scan Claude Code history (~/.claude/projects/) and "
                        "re-process all transcripts. Recovers sessions that "
                        "were created before the hook was installed.")
    p.add_argument("--source", metavar="SRC", default="all",
                   choices=["all", "claude", "sqlite", "opencode",
                            "mimocode", "cursor"],
                   help="With --backfill, which source to scan. "
                        "'all' (default) scans Claude Code + OpenCode + "
                        "MiMoCode + Cursor; "
                        "'claude' scans only ~/.claude/projects/; "
                        "'sqlite' scans OpenCode + MiMoCode SQLite; "
                        "'opencode' / 'mimocode' scans just that one; "
                        "'cursor' scans Cursor global + workspace state.vscdb.")
    p.add_argument("--force", action="store_true",
                   help="With --backfill, wipe the local staging first so all "
                        "transcripts are re-processed even if they were "
                        "captured before. Useful after cleaning logs/ to "
                        "rebuild from scratch.")
    p.add_argument("--github-login", metavar="LOGIN",
                   help="Restrict to one member's sessions.")
    p.add_argument("--dest", metavar="PATH",
                   help="Destination repo path. Defaults to git rev-parse --show-toplevel.")
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                   help="Force preview mode, do not write.")
    p.add_argument("--confirm", action="store_true",
                   help="Required to actually export. Without it, the tool only previews.")
    args = p.parse_args()

    sessions = list_sessions(args.github_login)

    if args.list:
        return cmd_list(args, sessions)

    if args.backfill:
        return cmd_backfill(args)

    if not any([args.latest, args.session, args.today, args.since, args.all]):
        p.print_help()
        sys.stderr.write("\nNothing to do. Pick one of "
                         "--latest, --session, --today, --since, --all, --list, --backfill.\n")
        return 2

    selected = filter_sessions(sessions, args)
    if not selected:
        sys.stderr.write("No sessions matched.\n")
        return 1

    dest = Path(args.dest) if args.dest else repo_root()
    if dest is None:
        sys.stderr.write("Cannot detect demo repo. "
                         "Run inside the repo or pass --dest.\n")
        return 2

    preview_only = args.dry_run or not args.confirm
    rc = 0
    for s in selected:
        ok, msg = copy_session(s, dest, preview_only)
        prefix = "✅" if ok else "❌"
        print(f"{prefix} {s['session_id'][:12]}  {msg}")
        if not ok:
            rc = 1

    if preview_only:
        print(f"\n[preview] {len(selected)} session(s) shown above. "
              "Nothing was written.")
        print("Re-run with --confirm to actually export, e.g.:")
        if args.latest:
            print("  python3 tools/export-session.py --latest --confirm")
        elif args.session:
            print(f"  python3 tools/export-session.py --session {args.session} --confirm")
        elif args.today:
            print("  python3 tools/export-session.py --today --confirm")
        elif args.since:
            print(f"  python3 tools/export-session.py --since {args.since} --confirm")
        elif args.all:
            print("  python3 tools/export-session.py --all --confirm")
    else:
        print(f"\n{len(selected)} session(s) exported to {dest}/logs/")
        print("Next: git add logs/ && git commit && git push")

    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
